title: C-String Subsequence Verification (No Built-ins)
statement: Write a C++ program to check whether a given string (word2) is a subsequence of another given string (word1). A subsequence is a sequence derived from another sequence by removing some elements without changing the order of the remaining elements. Do not use any built-in functions. Both word1 and word2 must be char arrays of maximum size 100.
expectedOutput: Input: word1 = 'apple'; word2 = 'apl'; -> Output: Yes, word2 is a subsequence of word1.
hints: Observe strict PF-lab constraints: avoid banned STL algorithms and classes.

title: Random 4-Letter Word Generator without Char Variables
statement: Write a C++ program that outputs a random word of length 4 using upper- and lower-case English alphabets (A-Z, a-z). Use a switch structure for selection wherever required. You cannot create a char variable or char array for any purpose.
hints: Observe strict PF-lab constraints: avoid banned STL algorithms and classes.
